2608.12007.title: Dual-Model Sentiment Analysis of Consumer Reviews in the Retail Coffee Sector Using Machine Learning and Deep Learning Approaches
2608.12007.paper_summary: Consumer reviews play an important role in shaping brand perception and business strategies, particularly in service-driven industries such as retail coffee. This study presents a comparative sentiment analysis framework for Starbucks customer reviews using classical machine learning and deep learning approaches. The dataset, collected from ConsumerAffairs, contains more than 700 reviews and was analyzed through preprocessing and exploratory data analysis to identify temporal and geographic patterns. Sentiment labels were generated by binarizing star ratings, with ratings of 4 and 5 classified as positive and ratings of 1 to 3 as negative. The resulting dataset was substantially imbalanced toward negative sentiment. Five machine learning classifiers, including Logistic Regression, Support Vector Machine (SVM), Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Naive Bayes, were evaluated alongside five deep learning models: LSTM, RNN, Bidirectional LSTM, GRU, and CNN. Model performance was assessed using accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. SVM achieved the highest accuracy among the machine learning models at 91.0 percent, while Bidirectional LSTM showed the strongest performance among the deep learning models and demonstrated good generalization on unseen data. The findings also show that class imbalance negatively affected positive sentiment recall across several models. Overall, this study provides a comparative evaluation of machine learning and deep learning approaches for real-world consumer sentiment analysis and highlights the importance of appropriate model selection and preprocessing for customer experience analytics in the retail coffee sector.
2608.12007.paper_summary_zh: 消費者評論在塑造品牌認知和商業策略中扮演著重要角色，特別是在以服務為驅動的行業，如零售咖啡。這項研究提出了一個比較情感分析框架，用於分析星巴克顧客評論，採用經典機器學習和深度學習方法。數據集來自ConsumerAffairs，包含超過700條評論，並通過預處理和探索性數據分析進行分析，以識別時間和地理模式。情感標籤是通過將星級評分二元化生成的，4和5的評分被歸類為正面，1到3的評分則被歸類為負面。最終的數據集在情感上顯著偏向負面。五種機器學習分類器，包括邏輯回歸、支持向量機（SVM）、決策樹、隨機森林和朴素貝葉斯，與五種深度學習模型進行了評估：LSTM、RNN、雙向LSTM、GRU和CNN。模型性能通過準確率、精確率、召回率和F1分數進行評估。SVM在機器學習模型中達到了91.0%的最高準確率，而雙向LSTM在深度學習模型中表現最強，並在未見數據上展示了良好的泛化能力。研究結果還顯示，類別不平衡對多個模型的正面情感召回率產生了負面影響。總體而言，這項研究提供了對現實世界消費者情感分析的機器學習和深度學習方法的比較評估，並強調了在零售咖啡行業中適當的模型選擇和預處理對顧客體驗分析的重要性。
